title: First pullback to session VWAP after a high-volume opening drive, three UTC sessions, 15m

source.title: Trading the First Pullback to VWAP in a Trending Stock

rule_summary: 15m closed bars, UTC; signal at a bar close, fill at the next open. Three sessions per day, each anchored at its open: A 00:00-07:45, E 08:00-13:15, U 13:30-23:45. Session VWAP(t) = sum(tp*vol)/sum(vol) of the session's bars up to t, tp=(h+l+c)/3. DRIVE (first 8 bars of the session): session high over those bars >= session open*1.012 AND their summed volume >= 1.5 * mean of the same 8-bar sum for the same session on the previous 14 days. TEST bar s: the first bar after bar 8 of a drive session whose low <= VWAP(s). If close(s) < VWAP(s), or volume(s) > mean volume of the session's bars before s, the session is void. ENTRY: if bar s+1 or s+2 closes above high(s), buy at the next open, provided the session high so far is >= 1% above that close and the bar opens at least 4 bars before session end. STOP = min(low(s), entry*0.99); skip if low(s) is more than 2.5% below entry. TAKE-PROFIT = the session high before entry. TIME EXIT after 12 bars (3 hours) or at the last bar of the session, whichever comes first. One trade per session.
mechanism: Execution algorithms benchmarked to VWAP and traders who missed the opening drive treat a return to VWAP as a fair price, so buyers are waiting there, while the pullback on light volume shows sellers are not pressing; the source states this rationale and cites the SPY first-half-hour/last-half-hour momentum finding. A 1.2% opening drive on 1.5x normal volume marks a session with real directional demand, which in crypto shows up at the Asian, European and US equity opens. The seller in the pullback is a short-term profit taker paying for immediacy. It differs from the lab's VWAP 2-sigma fade (H-086) and weekly VWAP reclaim (H-041): it buys only the first touch from above after a drive. Entries need at least 1% to the session high and a stop of at least 1%, so the gross target exceeds the 0.30-0.45% round trip.
